Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory148.png'}
{1: 'Port', 2: 'The Rainbow Bridge Base'}
{2: 'Rainbow Bridge, Port.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sieg', 3: 'A little further... right there...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'As the workboats crept forward, ribbons of light unspooled before them. Specks of luminescence lengthened into glowing threads, sewing the base to the endless dark sea one stitch at a time.'}
{3: 'The glow spread across the water, and beneath the surface, something stirred.'}
{3: 'Lumi recoiled in caution, throwing herself backward. A metal claw erupted from the water and clamped tight around the arm of the soldier standing beside her, yanking him below.'}
{3: 'The lights swung over at once. Where their beams crossed, the water turned bright red.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sieg', 3: 'Everyone, stay alert—', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His words were cut short as the boat heaved beneath them. The placid water suddenly churned.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'More than ten crab-like robots surged up along the hull, their metal claws catching the light with a dark, wet gleam.'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "Mannan-series engineering bots. They've been corrupted too... But this many? Where did they all come from?", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1578.jpg'}
{3: 'By that moment, the rescue detachment had returned to port as well.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "Move! Get off the water! We'll take it from here!", 4: '1'}
{3: "Only a handful remained on the water, and they began pulling back toward the port under the rescue detachment's covering fire."}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Gunshots cracked through the night, muzzle flares stabbing the dark and carving the hideous shapes of the machines into stark relief.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "We'll cover you. Get them ashore.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Making landfall was pure chaos.'}

{3: 'Every searchlight on the docks blazed to life, white beams raking the water and exposing the Corrupted as they scrabbled up from the sea. The soldiers aboard the ships and the ones holding the shore threw up interlocking fields of fire.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Lyndae! Get up here!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory148.png'}
{3: 'The moment the rescue boat slammed against the dock, soldiers vaulted over the side, guns blazing while their boots skidded across the drenched wood, churning water and blood into the air.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Limping Man', 3: 'Move... Out of my way! MOVE!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Pushing and jostling through the throng, a man with a crippled leg forced his way ahead of the others, charging down the gangway to where Lyndae stood with the baby in her arms.'}
{3: 'A Corrupted clambered onto the railing. A shot rang out, and the man staggered, toppling over the side toward the sea.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Limping Man', 3: 'Ahh!! Help me! Pull me up!', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Lyndae lunged forward and seized him, dragging him back onto the dock before shielding him as they scrambled up the gangplank.'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'In the same fluid motion, she stepped in front of the man, tucked the infant closer to her chest, and fired her sidearm at the Corrupted hauling itself over the railing.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront17.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront17.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'The round punched through its shell, and thick red ichor sprayed into the sea.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'But another machine was already sinking its claw blades into the metal and pulling itself over the edge.'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Limping Man', 3: 'G-get out of my way!', 4: '1'}
{3: "The man charged past Lyndae, his shoulder crashing hard into hers. The impact threw her off balance, and her body tilted violently toward the dock's edge."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1281.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: '1', 3: "In the water below, the Corrupted's eyes glimmered with faint red light in the darkness."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1281.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Lieutenant Lyndae!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Behind the mangled railing, Larsen caught Lyndae and held on tight. The metal, savaged by the repeated assaults of the Corrupted, screamed in protest and started to buckle.'}
{3: 'He threw his whole weight into pulling them back. All three hit the dock boards hard, sprawling across the wet timber.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'The baby!', 4: '18'}
{3: 'The baby fell to the ground, but she did not cry.'}

{3: 'The pier was strewn with the shattered remains of mechanical crabs, smoke and the stench of burning hanging heavy in the air. The man with the bad leg had fled into the base without a single glance behind him.'}
{3: "The water finally calmed. The night's final rescue run was over."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1581.jpg'}
{3: 'They had known about the unknown virus loose in the water, yet duty and compassion had never permitted them to stop.'}
{3: 'Every trip out had been worse than the one before it.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Phew...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The makeshift treatment room was crammed with casualties. Not wanting to pile more weight onto Lumi, Lyndae slipped away and dressed her injuries alone in the walkway outside.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Lieutenant Lyndae, we brought bandages.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia followed close behind Larsen, a rudimentary medical kit clutched in her grip, her forehead creased with concern.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Thanks.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia set the medkit down beside Lyndae.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...Had your fill yet, big hero? This is just day one.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'It only gets uglier from here.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Deactivating the central AI at Rainbow Bridge had not made the sea safe. The Punishing Virus still held sway, and each stretch of time brought fresh swarms of Corrupted.'}
{3: 'And alongside them came the full, mottled spectrum of human weakness.'}
{3: "Cordelia and Lyndae understood this perfectly. Larsen was the only one who still hadn't caught up."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'These damn machines... nothing but a pain. And the supplies were barely worth it...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "You should change. You're soaked in blood. Are you injured?", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Lyndae shook her head.'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "Not mine. Most of it... it's from that girl. The one with the baby.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Green hair. Looked pretty young...', 4: '1'}
{3: "At those words, Cordelia's hands froze mid-motion."}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "The baby hasn't cried. Shock, probably. Too scared to make a sound.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A green-haired girl wearing glasses, with a baby.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'White Stork...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The absurdity of it all was unbearable.'}
{3: 'She broke into a run through the endless dark, charging straight for the treatment room.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory41.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'In the treatment room, Lumi accepted the strangely silent infant and placed her on the examination bed.'}
{3: 'When she pressed the stethoscope to the tiny chest, the heartbeat that came through was steady and mechanical, like the ticking of a metronome.'}
{3: "Lumi frowned and tested the baby's pupillary reflex again."}
{3: 'When the penlight beam hit her eyes, those golden irises constricted slowly—a normal reaction, technically.'}
{3: 'But the speed was wrong, far too sluggish, like the response of a cold-blooded animal barely awake.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: '...Vitals check out. But the way she reacts...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She left the rest of the words unspoken.'}
{3: 'Without the evidence of warm skin, she was little more than a doll whose switch had been left in the off position.'}
{3: "The door slammed open under Cordelia's hands, and a damp sea wind flooded into the room."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Let me... let me see her.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'With careful fingers, Cordelia folded back the edge of the swaddling cloth, uncovering the full shape of a small crest hidden beneath.'}
{3: 'She covered the crest in a single, sharp motion. It belonged to the Erhorn lab.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(I found you...)', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'It really is you.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The precious thing she had taken in secret was back with her at last.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Ms. Erhorn, this baby...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia gathered the child close and held her firm against her chest.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "She's fine.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "...She's an Erhorn. This crest... is the proof.", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront180.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Cordelia pulled up the matching insignia from her device, the very same mark stamped across papers issued by a laboratory under the Erhorn name.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront180.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Erhorn...? Why would an Erhorn child be out here?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Leave her with me. I'll take good care of her.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg'}
{3: 'A radiant dawn lifted from the horizon, and the endless night finally broke.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia stood on the port platform, the ocean wind threading through her hair and grazing her cheeks.'}
{3: "She brushed her fingers over the baby's forehead. Those golden eyes gazed back in silence, holding her reflection within them."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "You're not a test subject anymore. You don't belong to anyone now.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia laid her palm lightly over the small crest and swayed the baby with a slow, gentle rhythm.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "White Stork... you brought her home. They'll never find either of you now.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTrial/FxUiTrialGet.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'A faint blue light kindled at her fingertips and spread over the intricate mark, burning it away until nothing remained but a small, uneven scar.'}
{3: "She destroyed the coded mark that once defined the child's identity."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTrial/FxUiTrialGet.prefab'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Sorry... Did that hurt?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The process should have been painful.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Yet the child neither stirred nor wept.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia bowed her head, her grieving eyes finding those golden pupils. And then, very softly, she smiled.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: '"Little monster."', 4: '1'}
{3: "The infant's lashes gave a faint tremble."}
{3: 'That gentle smile and that tender warmth felt like something she had once held tightly in her grasp.'}
{3: 'But in the end, only crimson remained, pooling in her golden eyes.'}
{3: "Cordelia froze for a moment, then reached out and brushed her fingers against the baby's cheek."}
{3: 'That long-ago cry had been the last noise she made, the only reaction she had ever offered to the world. This was the first since then.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Who taught you...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Who taught you how to cry, and who lit the spark of your soul?'}
{3: 'Giving life was a solemn and brutal thing, one awareness rousing another from the void.'}
{3: 'Making it understand it existed. Letting it feel, letting it think. Preparing it to face its own annihilation.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'White Stork...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory787.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront32.png', 4: '4'}
{1: '1', 3: "What remained of that timid, green-haired girl from Kalon's laboratory was only a bloodied infant's blanket."}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{3: 'Inside it, a new existence had begun, unaware of all that had been sacrificed.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront32.png', 4: '4', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1580.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The sea wind caught her tears and carried them off. Cordelia pivoted and started toward the base.'}
{3: 'Then a faint sound stirred the air, and she turned her head sharply, frowning.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Who's there?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "Lumi said the wind's too strong out here... It's not really...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "Larsen shuffled forward and took his place at Cordelia's side, visibly nervous."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "If you've got something to say, spit it out.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "The baby... she's, uh, pretty cute... ha, haha.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'I said spit it out. And yes, she is cute.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'What you said to Lyndae earlier. About things only getting uglier... You mean...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'It means exactly that. More attacks, wave after wave, just like last night.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Humanity thought it had the ocean under control. That means there are countless machines out here, all of them waiting to be corrupted.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "We shut down Frigga, sure... But who's to say an offline AI can't still get corrupted?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Larsen rubbed his face anxiously, trying to settle himself.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "This place... it's not safe anymore.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her sentence hung unfinished as the ground lurched.'}
{3: "Light and sound exploded from the base's missile silo, a white-hot javelin tearing through the sky with terrible fury."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Anti-ship missile?! What's happening?!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: 'The bright white arc curved sharply toward the ocean, skimming low over the wave crests as it shot southeast. Dark silhouettes, shaped like ships, sat clustered on the horizon.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1580.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '(And no matter what era, people never stop feeding on each other.)', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 4: '4', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory295.png'}
{3: 'BOOM. A mushroom cloud swelled upward into the heavens.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1580.jpg'}

{3: 'Cordelia hugged the infant closer without thinking, sheltering her from the wall of sound. Lost in the overwhelming noise, she did not see the sharp contraction that flickered through those golden eyes.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "What's going on...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Just as Larsen was trying to get confirmation from inside the base, a second missile shot out of the silo.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Unresponsive passenger ships... We tried hailing them multiple times. No response.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia showed no surprise. She had done the same thing herself not so long ago, sinking a warship with these very weapons.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Did Gunnar give the order?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "I... I don't know...", 4: '2'}
{3: 'This time, she exhaled a soft sigh.'}
{3: 'The relentless blows of fate had made skittish creatures of them all. The motive behind that finger on the trigger—sense, dread, or spite—had stopped to matter.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1580.jpg'}
{3: 'Sensing something, Cordelia glanced down. The baby in her arms was staring blankly at the distant fire.'}
{3: "Her eyes had opened wide, the way a real child's would."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Are you... scared?', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory295.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'Across the ocean, the blast bloomed orange, smoke and cloud coiling upward in gray-white heaps.'}
{3: 'Fires punched through the fissures in the clouds, each one a distended heart bulging, pulsing, and then exploding into shreds.'}
{3: 'The hideous fire, the warped sky, the bodies pressing closer, blood flying, the sound of metal tearing human flesh.'}
{3: 'She tried with everything she was to wail, but the "thing" inside her that wanted to shout was hollow and weightless, with no permission to make a noise.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory295.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{3: "The baby's breathing grew rapid and shallow, her small chest rising and falling in quick, uneven bursts. She stared ahead, motionless, as if she had forgotten she could simply close her eyes."}
{3: 'From the moment she had opened her eyes, what kind of world had this child been forced to witness?'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1361.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'The screaming, the wailing, the blasts, and the tearing of bodies. The red of raw flesh, the white of naked bones, the raging fire, and the columns of smoke...'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory789.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Or perhaps even before that: the sterile, rhythmic beeping of machines, the endless, featureless white, the ice-cold eyes and voices of the researchers.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Cordelia let out a quiet sigh.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "To be honest... I really don't like the place I've been living in.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "But, little monster... the world isn't just this.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Under Larsen's surprised stare, Cordelia raised the baby a little higher in her embrace."}
{3: 'So that the tiny life could sense that a warm body stood between her and the ocean of fire.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'You heard it, right? So loud, so bright... Fireworks sound like that too.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'My teacher Kalon once told me... our universe was born the same way. From destruction came new life.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Birth was always attended by agony, and destruction was forever inscribed upon the other side of protection.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_63.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Look... it's a blue rippled glass table. The sunlight's melting the banana split. And that's cotton candy, so round and fluffy. It tastes sweet.", 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_60.jpg'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{3: 'Out on the water, the ruined ships tilted gradually, their steel plates peeling outward like the petals of some terrible flower.'}
{3: 'Rivers of white-hot molten metal streamed soundlessly down the slanted hull, their brilliance lighting the sea from within until it glowed transparent.'}
{3: 'Yet in the distance, the water stayed untouched, as blue and clear as glass.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Another wave of missiles struck.'}

{3: 'Fireballs swelled across the sea surface, and shattered wreckage flew upward, threading through the white exhaust trails until the world looked upside down, a storm of meteors climbing from the sea toward the heavens.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_63.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'The sun melted all the ice cream. The clown cried so hard he let go of every last balloon...', 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_60.jpg'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{3: 'The flames still gnawed at everything on the water, devouring the world piece by piece. Cordelia cradled the soft, tiny body and turned her back to the sea of falling fire.'}
{3: "The violence was now behind them, unseen. Only a warm orange glow reached the child's face, gentle as sunlight filtered through summer leaves."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Red is blood. Red is fire. But red is also flowers and kisses... That's the color I want you to see.", 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew01.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_60.jpg', 7: '70|100|-200'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangBegin'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_60.jpg', 7: '223|-255|-400'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangBegin'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_60.jpg', 7: '-230|-190|-300'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangBegin'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_63.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew01.prefab'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: "She extended her right hand and brought it slowly toward the baby's face. The infant's gaze followed the movement, tracking a moving object for the very first time in her short life."}
{3: 'The calm presence of her protector stilled the trembling in those small eyes, replacing it with something bright and spirited.'}
{3: "Cordelia's hand swept past like a stream of water."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "So many balloons... Look how high they're flying... so high...", 4: '18'}
